name: dnstwist Domain Impersonation Scanner
free_limit: Apache-2.0 local Python CLI and Docker tool for generating domain-name permutations, checking DNS registrations and identifying potential typosquatting or phishing domains; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Not a free hosted DNS provider or continuous monitoring subscription. Requires your own machine, network, DNS resolvers and optional web-content comparison dependencies; bulk DNS requests can hit rate limits or third-party fees. Use responsibly for authorized brand/domain monitoring.
